events.title: First COBOL program executed
events.summary: The first COBOL program ran on an RCA 501, proving the new business language could compile and execute.
events.about: This proved COBOL could replace custom assembly for business apps. The same program later ran on another vendor's hardware — the whole point was one language for invoices, accounts, and reports across different computer brands.

narrative.whyChosen: Specifications matter; a running program proved COBOL was more than a committee document.
narrative.whyImportant: By December 1960 the same program ran on multiple vendors' machines, demonstrating portability.
narrative.problemSolved: Skeptics doubted a common business language could be implemented by competing hardware makers.
